name: TrendPulse - AI Trend Intelligence for Tech Creators
description: A daily trend intelligence system that finds trending Tech + AI topics relevant to software developers, ranks them, and generates ready-to-post content in the user's voice.

userStories.title: Project Setup & Database
acceptanceCriteria: Create database migrations for all tables
Add basic auth with magic link (Supabase Auth)

userStories.title: Data Source Connectors
acceptanceCriteria: RSS connector for TechCrunch, Verge, Ars Technica
Rate limiting and caching for all connectors

userStories.title: Trend Scoring Engine
acceptanceCriteria: Implement scoring algorithm (velocity, cross-platform, relevance, novelty)
API endpoint to get daily top 5 trends

userStories.title: Voice Profile System
acceptanceCriteria: Extract patterns: tone, structure, emoji usage, CTAs, phrases
Use profile in content generation prompts
Allow multiple profiles (LinkedIn voice vs Twitter voice)

userStories.title: Content Generation Pipeline
acceptanceCriteria: Angle selector: hot take, tutorial, founder story, meme
Reply bank generator (5 spicy replies per trend)

userStories.title: Dashboard UI
acceptanceCriteria: Daily digest page with 5 ranked trends
Each trend shows: summary, why it matters, signals, links
Expandable sections for video ideas and drafts

userStories.title: Export & Integrations
acceptanceCriteria: Email digest (daily at 7 AM user timezone)

userStories.title: Scheduled Jobs
acceptanceCriteria: Vercel Cron job to fetch sources (every 2 hours)
Daily email digest job (per user timezone)
